name: Eye
overview: Scripture reveals that God's watchful eye is intimately attentive to those who fear Him and place their hope in His mercy, as seen in Psalms 33:18-19 and Psalms 34:15. The Lord’s eyes are upon the righteous, ensuring their deliverance and sustaining them in times of need. Furthermore, God's vigilant care is unceasing, never slumbering or sleeping, as affirmed in Psalms 121:3-4, emphasizing His constant protection and guidance for His people.
